entries.capability_summary: telegram-stickers (community, maintained by churnast) Lets your agent answer in Telegram with a sticker, the way a person reacts to a joke or good news: four default packs made by Telegram out of the box, then packs you list or send the bot in a direct chat; picked by emoji or by meaning, sent as a reply in the current chat and forum topic, paced per chat, with a per-chat off switch the agent cannot undo. Pace and packs can be set in words in your direct chat. Disclosure: calls only the Telegram Bot API (api.telegram.org or the configured api_base) with the gateway's TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, read through Hermes' secret scope: getStickerSet for the packs in use (during the first-run setup also from a short background thread, only for a sender Hermes answers, at most 32 at once), sendSticker, and getFile plus one download per sticker for /stickers describe, which the owner starts and which sends each sticker image to the vision model configured in Hermes. A native Telegram handler sees stickers sent to the bot in direct chats (not in groups), skips forwarded ones and keeps pack name, sticker kind and sender id in memory for up to an hour; everyone the bot answers in a direct chat can add packs, up to max_learned_packs in all (default 100, 0 for no limit; learn_packs: false turns learning off). A pre_llm_call hook appends fixed text to the user message of Telegram turns: a sticker hint of about 540 characters, a settings note of about 310 characters when the message mentions stickers, or a setup paragraph during the first-run setup. Writes catalog.json, descriptions.json and state.json under plugin-data/telegram-stickers/ and reads Hermes' sticker_cache.json. No middleware: the sticker tools run through Hermes like any tool. Uses Hermes functions outside the plugin API (tools.vision_tools.vision_analyze_tool, gateway.session_context.get_session_env) and reads the call stack to tell the local CLI or TUI from other callers of /stickers. No shell commands, telemetry or self-update. Anyone the bot answers in a direct chat counts as the owner: they can change pacing, packs, banned stickers and per-chat on/off; the off switch the agent cannot undo holds in groups only. This plugin registers tool(s): telegram_sticker_find, telegram_sticker_send, telegram_sticker_mute, telegram_sticker_settings; hook(s): pre_llm_call; requires env var(s): TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Platforms: linux, macos, windows. Requires Hermes >=0.20.6. Known issues: Needs plugins.isolation: in_process (the default). Under plugins.isolation: host it cannot see the current chat, so it sends no stickers, learns no packs and adds no hint.; Every person the bot answers in a direct chat adds packs (up to max_learned_packs, default 100), which the agent then uses in every chat. Keep the gateway allowlist to yourself, or set learn_packs: false.; Before Hermes 0.21.5, /stickers in Telegram only shows the status and reloads packs; the owner's other /stickers commands work in the Hermes CLI on the server.; Where tool progress is on, Hermes posts its progress line (such as telegram_sticker_send...) before a sticker; display.platforms.telegram.tool_progress: off hides every tool's lines in Telegram..

entries.capability_summary: telegram_dashboard_probe (community, maintained by bablobanov) One pinned Telegram message with the state of your Hermes on one phone screen: gateway, backup, config drift, the cron ticker and its jobs, whether the Telegram channel is deaf, whether the agent sees its rules and whether its memory writes stand unapproved, account limits and version. Read-only, no LLM calls, nothing to press. Disclosure — Claude and Codex limits come from Hermes' own account-usage fetcher, called every tick (which, like /usage, may refresh OAuth tokens through Hermes' own auth code); at most once per limits_refresh_seconds (default 900 s) the Grok weekly pool is read from https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/billing and /v1/settings with the xai-oauth token Hermes resolves (which, like any Hermes request to xAI, may refresh that OAuth token and save it to auth.json, or clear a dead one, through Hermes' own auth code), sending the header x-xai-token-auth xai-grok-cli that identifies the request as the Grok CLI (an undocumented xAI host Hermes itself does not use), and Kimi Code windows from the kimi-coding base URL /v1/usages with the kimi-coding key Hermes resolves (which, like any Hermes key lookup without a usable key in .env or the environment, may save Hermes' credential pool back to auth.json once when loading it changes something, e.g. a placeholder key in .env) and a User-Agent of claude-code/0.1.0 (undocumented provider surfaces), and up to four operator-configured limits_sources, if set, each with one GET to http on loopback only (127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1), with no proxy and no redirect, optionally sending Authorization: Bearer with the value of an environment variable the operator names (never a *_BOT_TOKEN one); every tick the tail of HERMES_HOME/logs/errors.log (the last 256 KB; the whole file, up to 4 MB, until the first successful read) is read for Gemini HTTP 429 lines, of which only the time, limit, retry and model are kept, and for the engine's own 'Failed to send Telegram message' lines, of which only the time is kept, never the message text; with a memory provider configured, the last 256 KB of the same log are also read for the engine's warnings about that provider, of which only the time and whether one says unavailable are kept; every tick HERMES_HOME/cron/jobs.json is read for each job's id, name, enabled flag, state, times, status and failure streak (never prompt, script, deliver, skills or the model) and the ticker's marker files for their epoch, and HERMES_HOME/cron/executions.db is opened read-only (sqlite3 mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only, in a worker under the tick's deadline) for the job_id, status, delivery_outcome and time columns of failed or undelivered runs, never the error column; the engine's error texts are reduced to the kind of the error in a word and never reach the screen or the record; the connected Telegram adapter's public property send_path_degraded is read every tick, and, as a capability and not a contract, four private attributes of the live adapter object (_updates_received_total, _polling_generation, _polling_last_progress_monotonic, _polling_generation_started_monotonic) are read as attributes, nothing is called on it, and an adapter without them shows no data for that line; every tick HERMES_HOME/state.db is opened read-only the same way for the newest saved system prompt of each platform the running gateway lists in HERMES_HOME/gateway_state.json, and the project context files the engine would load (.hermes.md or HERMES.md in that directory and each parent up to the git root, the AGENTS.override.md / AGENTS.md / agents.md chain from the git root down, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules and .cursor/rules/*.mdc; up to 4 MB each, links followed as the engine follows them) are read from the directory that prompt names (else the engine's TERMINAL_CWD or the gateway's working directory), and .hermes.md, HERMES.md and the AGENTS names also from the gateway's working directory and HERMES_HOME, which may be outside HERMES_HOME; to tell whether the prompt carries them as they are on disk; only a verdict, the file names, sizes and times are kept, never the prompt's or a file's text; every tick HERMES_HOME/memories/MEMORY.md and USER.md (up to 4 MB each) are read to count their characters against the limits, the waiting writes in HERMES_HOME/pending/memory and pending/skills (up to 2,000 files) for their names and times and, of the memory ones (up to 256 KB each), each add's target and length, and the time of HERMES_HOME/skills/.curator_ledger.jsonl; never a notebook's, an entry's or a waiting write's text, and nothing there is written; the private hermes_cli.version_info._cached_version_info and the signature of agent.prompt_builder._read_text_with_timeout are read from modules the gateway already imported, and nothing is called or changed on them; the release check keeps only each release's version and publication time and downloads, installs or replaces nothing; config.yaml is read through Hermes' own YAML parser for the memory limits, switches, approval gate and provider name, skills.write_approval and each platform's skip_context_files; the plugin's own code never reads the Telegram bot token and never writes vendor credential files (Hermes' auth code it calls for Grok and Kimi may, as said above), and no request the plugin's own code sends with a token in a header follows a redirect; the latest Hermes release is read from api.github.com without a token at most once per 15 minutes (releases/latest with the last answer's ETag; the release list releases?per_page=100 only when Latest names another version); an operator-configured drift_command, if set, runs as a subprocess; the delivery record is written under HERMES_HOME/plugin-data/. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars. Requires Hermes >=0.21.1. Known issues: Requires in-process plugin execution: the Telegram handler factory receives the platform's native SDK client, which plugins.isolation: host does not allow; under host the plugin does not load and nothing is delivered..

entries.capability_summary: thomas (community, maintained by keppy) Fine-tune a small calibrated encoder classifier on Modal and rate it with gonogo. Every GPU launch goes through the human approval gate with the exact config shown; data checks and evaluation run locally for free. Disclosure — thomas_encoder_train spends the user's Modal GPU credits and uploads the chosen training JSONL rows to Modal after the human approval gate; the base model is downloaded from Hugging Face on the Modal side. Training and inference run in a separate Python interpreter the user configures via THOMAS_PYTHON (with the author's thomas package, torch and modal installed); the Hermes venv only gets gonogo-eval. Runs and artifacts are written under HERMES_HOME/thomas/runs; the eval tool writes report files to the path the model supplies. This plugin registers tool(s): thomas_check_data, thomas_encoder_train, thomas_run_status, thomas_encoder_eval; hook(s): pre_tool_call. Platforms: linux, macos. Requires Hermes >=0.21.

entries.capability_summary: tinyfish (community, maintained by tinyfish-io) First-party TinyFish plugin: free Search and Fetch as a web provider, plus credit-gated remote Browser sessions and the tinyfish_agent web agent. Disclosure — sends search queries, URLs to fetch and tinyfish_agent goals with your TINYFISH_API_KEY to the TinyFish API (*.tinyfish.ai). Browser sessions and tinyfish_agent runs spend TinyFish credits. Under the default `request` policy each one goes through Hermes's approval prompt first (a session/always answer covers every later call; cron and unattended runs are denied unless you allow them). Setting `tinyfish.credit_policy.<feature>: allow` or YOLO skips the prompt. `hermes tinyfish setup` / `browser enable` (run by you) save the key to Hermes .env, set web.search_backend/extract_backend and browser.cloud_provider in config.yaml, enable the web/browser toolsets, and can install the agent-browser CLI after asking. This plugin registers tool(s): tinyfish_agent; hook(s): pre_tool_call, pre_llm_call, on_session_finalize; requires env var(s): TINYFISH_API_KEY. Requires Hermes >=0.19.

entries.capability_summary: titanos-mcp (community, maintained by Titanos) Connect Hermes to Titanos marketplace, Amazon, listings, Ads, and product research tools through the pinned Titanos OAuth MCP client. This portable Agent Plugin v1 package bundles seven operating skills, requires Node.js 20.18.1 or newer, and uses browser authorization with a Titanos account. Disclosure — starts the npm package @titanos/mcp-agents@1.47.2 via npx (fetched from npm on first run); its tools read and WRITE live marketplace/Ads accounts under your Titanos OAuth session. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars.

entries.capability_summary: token-cost-meter (community, maintained by IT-dreamer) Live token usage, model-aware USD cost and prompt-cache savings in the Hermes Desktop status bar, with a persistent per-day ledger that survives restarts. Disclosure — Desktop only; no network calls of its own (prices come from the gateway's model.options and a bundled models.dev rate table); stores per-day token totals, per-session counters and last-known rates in its own Desktop plugin storage; costs are list-price estimates, not billing data. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars. Requires Hermes >=0.21.6.

entries.capability_summary: tool-slimmer (community, maintained by aliasocracy) Reduce Hermes tool-schema overhead and show selector savings in the dashboard. Disclosure — optional mode jev (off by default; needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY) sends each turn's request text and up to 32 candidate tool names and descriptions to TypeSafe (api.typesafe.ai); all other modes run locally. Optional user-run scripts can patch Hermes core on older Hermes and install a systemd user self-heal unit; the dashboard advisor edits the tool_slimmer section of config.yaml with a backup. This plugin registers tool(s): tool_slimmer_hydrate_tools, tool_slimmer_request_full_tools, tool_slimmer_select, tool_slimmer_status; hook(s): pre_llm_call; middleware: llm_request. Requires Hermes >=0.19.

entries.capability_summary: ttsbuddy (community, maintained by ngelik) Native TTS Buddy speech provider using the existing TTS Buddy CLI, with offline voice selection, MP3 generation, Hermes voice-message conversion and exact-job recovery, plus terminal-only account deletion through CLI 0.16.0+. Disclosure — runs the user-installed `ttsbuddy` CLI (argument array, speech text on stdin), which sends the text and voice settings to TTS Buddy, downloads the hosted audio and uses the account's quota. Credentials come from the profile's `TTSBUDDY_API_KEY` secret or, when the user selects `cli_config_dir`, from that CLI profile's own saved login, which the CLI may read and update. The model-callable `ttsbuddy_recover` tool downloads an existing job to a new MP3 path the model chooses (never overwrites). The terminal command `hermes ttsbuddy account delete` can permanently delete the TTS Buddy account, its hosted files and identity, and cancel subscriptions, after `--yes` and a fresh email code entered at a hidden prompt or protected stdin. This plugin registers tool(s): ttsbuddy_recover. Platforms: linux, macos. Requires Hermes >=0.21.7. Known issues: Account deletion is terminal-only, requires CLI 0.16.0+ and an explicit persistent cli_config_dir; speech credentials do not authorize deletion.; Use fresh unique output filenames/stems: successful Hermes delivery and same-stem Opus conversion can replace files outside the provider's no-clobber checks.; MP3 source audio only; no PCM streaming. A local timeout does not cancel an accepted hosted job; use ttsbuddy_recover with the exact job ID..

entries.capability_summary: unitares (community, maintained by cirwel) Records each Hermes session on a UNITARES server you run: one identity per session and one check-in per completed turn, so the agent's working record carries across sessions. Fail-open; never blocks the agent. Disclosure — sends only to the server named in UNITARES_MCP_URL, which you host; there is no default server. Per session it sends your model name and platform; per completed turn a fixed check-in marker (never user, assistant or tool text). Hooks run synchronously, so an unresponsive server can delay a call by roughly 40 seconds (connection plus call timeout). After 3 consecutive failures the plugin stops reporting for that session only, until the session is finalized or reset; it stays fail-open and never blocks the agent. If UNITARES_BEARER is set, it is sent as a request header to that same server only. This plugin hook(s): on_session_finalize, on_session_reset, on_session_start, post_llm_call, pre_llm_call; requires env var(s): UNITARES_MCP_URL. Requires Hermes >=0.21.0.

entries.capability_summary: usage-guard (community, maintained by mister-ideas) Keeps an agent inside its subscription allowance: refuses a provider dispatch once a subscription usage window is exhausted, so an account that allows paid extra usage stops at the wall instead of spending overage. Reads the usage Hermes already displays, holds no credentials, and never touches account or billing settings. Disclosure — refuses main-loop provider calls (including MoA turns) for the providers in `provider_keys` (Anthropic and OpenAI Codex by default) when a subscription usage window reaches `threshold_percent`, and by default (`fail_open: false`) also refuses when usage data is missing, stale, unreadable, or the guard's own config is malformed; usage is read through Hermes's own account-usage fetcher (no credentials held, at most one read per source every 180 seconds by default) and cached in $HERMES_HOME/plugin-data/usage-guard/usage.json; auxiliary calls (compression, vision, titles, MoA advisors) are not gated. This plugin middleware: llm_execution. Requires Hermes >=0.21.6. Known issues: Anthropic windows: Hermes's Anthropic fetcher scales any utilization <= 1 by 100, so a window at 0-1% can read as 100% and the guard will refuse. Fixed upstream by NousResearch/hermes-agent#139916; this entry's requires_hermes rises to the release carrying it..

entries.capability_summary: vaultknox (community, maintained by Ufonik88) Secret-leak protection for Hermes chats. Scans inbound messages and outbound replies for API keys, tokens, and passwords with a 28-pattern detector registry, redacts them before they reach session storage or the user, and injects safe secret-handling rules so the agent never asks for secrets in chat. Zero dependencies, fully offline detection; pairs with the optional hermes-vault CLI for encrypted storage. Disclosure — rewrites inbound user messages (regex secret redaction, may false-positive on password-like strings), injects a secret-handling prompt each conversation and rewrites assistant replies that ask for secrets; outbound replies are value-redacted with the same registry (regex-based, so a shape no detector covers passes through), with findings logged as detector name plus SHA-256 fingerprint and never the raw value. The vaultknox tool is inert unless the separate vaultknox pip package is installed, its write gate is a tool argument the model sets, and a vault policy that authorises raw consume_token returns the plaintext to the model. This plugin registers tool(s): vaultknox; hook(s): pre_gateway_dispatch, pre_llm_call, transform_llm_output. Requires Hermes >=0.19.

entries.capability_summary: vector-platform (community, maintained by BonesGit) Vector (vectorapp.io) messaging platform plugin: Hermes becomes a first-class Nostr-based Vector bot (its own nsec/npub identity), relaying DMs through a local Rust sidecar that wraps vector-sdk. First run needs `hermes gateway setup`, which provisions the bot identity (create or import). Disclosure — `hermes gateway setup` downloads a prebuilt vector-bridge binary from github.com/BonesGit/hermes-vector-platform/releases (tag v<version>, sha256 checked against that release's SHA256SUMS; set vector.prebuilt.download: false to build from the bundled Rust source), merges `vector:` settings into ~/.hermes/config.yaml, writes VECTOR_* to ~/.hermes/.env, and publishes a public bot profile (kind-0, bot: true) to Nostr discovery relays. This plugin requires env var(s): VECTOR_NPUB.

Disclosure — talks only to the self-hosted Vornik daemon at VORNIK_URL with VORNIK_BROKER_TOKEN (and VORNIK_MEMORY_TOKEN for memory); broker tools let the agent start operator-approved workflows on that daemon (writes are approved by a person in Vornik); when selected as memory provider it sends each turn's user query for recall, mirrors MEMORY.md and USER.md writes to the daemon, and asks the daemon to stop recalling (not delete) a mirrored entry that Hermes removes or replaces (/vornik-memory lists and /vornik-forget forgets what Vornik keeps); artifact tools expose only named outputs allowed by the approved workflow from completed runs and read bounded text or return short-lived binary download links from the daemon; task diagnosis tools (offered only when the daemon advertises companion-progress) return a broker task's execution events and closed error classes as the daemon serves them to a broker key; hermes vornik approvals on writes security.approval.transport (and vornik_companion.approval_namespace) to Hermes config, after which Hermes's own dangerous-command prompts (the redacted command text) are sent through the local vornikctl agent host-approval to the daemon and answered on the paired phone, any failure or a Vornik outage denying the command unless transport_fallback: builtin is set, and the plugin never decides itself; hermes vornik connect runs the local vornikctl, which adds an MCP entry to Hermes config. This plugin registers tool(s): vornik_catalog, vornik_delegate, vornik_result, vornik_status, vornik_cancel, vornik_list_artifacts, vornik_read_artifact, vornik_task_logs, vornik_task_explain, vornik_recall, vornik_remember; hook(s): pre_llm_call; requires env var(s): VORNIK_URL, VORNIK_BROKER_TOKEN, VORNIK_MEMORY_TOKEN. Requires Hermes >=0.21.5.

entries.capability_summary: wallpaper-theme (community, maintained by strnadchristopher) A Hermes Desktop theme that follows your wallpaper. Reads Pywal's ~/.cache/wal/colors.json by default, or any palette JSON you point it at (settings page or ~/.config/hermes-wallpaper-theme/config.json), derives a palette with checked contrast floors and repaints live when the file changes. Optional glass mode paints a translucent background for native window materials or compositor blur. Disclosure — the desktop half uses only @hermes/plugin-sdk; the palette file is read by the package's own backend route (dashboard/plugin_api.py, GET /api/plugins/wallpaper-theme/palette, mounted once the plugin is in plugins.enabled), polled every 3 seconds with a change stamp. That route reads only JSON files inside the user's home directory (or XDG_*_HOME) under 256 KiB and returns colour fields only, never raw file text. No network calls, no shell commands, no credentials, no telemetry. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars. Platforms: linux, macos, windows. Requires Hermes >=0.22.1.

entries.capability_summary: waypoint (community, maintained by mochiNJ) Session status for Hermes Desktop: a thin bar next to every sidebar session with four states — Working (remembers your next step), Waiting on someone (who/what plus a follow-up reminder), Done (outcome plus a fresh-start handoff) and untracked. Suggests 3 next steps per session (instant quick ideas from the chat, opt-in AI ideas from the auxiliary model, priority colours) with one-click Ask, a Power up button that asks a strong model for sharper ideas on demand, and Mark complete to stop suggestions. Adds a Status Board page (columns, follow-ups due, stale sessions, archive all done), triage of untracked sessions, a resume banner above the composer, a status-bar counter, a daily summary, palette commands and English/Arabic (RTL). SDK-only: session-row slots, a route, sidebar nav, status bar, composer banner, palette. Disclosure — no network calls of its own (all model calls go through Hermes llm.oneshot); AI next-step suggestions are OFF by default; when enabled, after new replies (at most every 90 s) the plugin sends the focused session's last ~12 user/assistant messages (≤ ~7,000 chars) plus its title and the user's notes to the auxiliary task title_generation (Hermes default "auto" = your main model); Power up runs only when pressed — also with AI suggestions off — and sends a longer excerpt (last ~20 messages, ≤ ~12,000 chars) to the plugin's own auxiliary tasks waypoint_ideas / waypoint_ideas_2 (registered by __init__.py; unset they resolve to "auto" = your main model) or, for "My chat model", to the open session's model; an optional automatic big idea (off by default) uses the same choice at most every 10 minutes; Power up call log (2.5.0): the Python half also registers two observe-only hooks (pre_auxiliary_call, post_auxiliary_call) that ignore every auxiliary task except waypoint_ideas / waypoint_ideas_2 and, for those, write one line per call to the user's own Hermes log (logs/agent.log) and append a record to <HERMES_HOME>/plugin-data/waypoint/power-calls.jsonl (rolls over at ~1 MB): model, provider, reasoning effort, response time, token counts (logged as 'unknown' with a reason when Hermes reports none), finish reason and status — never prompt, message or reply text, nothing leaves the machine, and the hooks never modify a call; reads session history (session.history) and titles (session.list); statuses, notes and cached suggestion text are kept in desktop plugin storage; archives sessions only when you press Archive (undo offered) or confirm "Archive N done" on the board (no undo; sessions stay under Archived); posts in-app and native OS notifications for due reminders and a once-a-day local summary; writes composer drafts only on Ask / Insert / Start fresh session and never sends them. This plugin hook(s): pre_auxiliary_call, post_auxiliary_call. Requires Hermes >=0.21.6.

entries.capability_summary: wechat-social-assistant (community, maintained by harrylabsj) Local-first WeChat relationship memory assistant for macOS: captures only what is visible in the WeChat window via system OCR/Accessibility, stores everything in a local SQLite database (0600/0700 permissions, no cloud), and serves contact briefs, follow-up planning, outreach drafts and weekly relationship reports through 32 MCP tools. Engine pinned to the immutable PyPI release wechat-social-assistant==1.5.1 over uvx stdio; Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), needs uv on PATH. All data confined to PLUGIN_DATA via WSA_ALLOWED_ROOT + path enforcement. Never reads WeChat databases, never injects into WeChat, never sends messages — outreach is drafts for human review only. Disclosure — reads WeChat only by screenshotting/OCR-ing and walking the macOS Accessibility tree of the frontmost window (not WeChat's databases or a bot API), compiles bundled Swift helpers with swiftc into ~/Library/Caches/wechat-social-assistant/bin on first use, and needs Screen Recording (optionally Accessibility) permission for the host terminal; no network egress, never sends messages. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars. Platforms: macos.

entries.capability_summary: whatsapp-agent-platform (community, maintained by ahtishamdilawar) Community platform plugin (not affiliated with Meta or Nous Research) connecting a WhatsApp Agent to Hermes through Meta's WhatsApp Agent Platform API (/agent/v1): long-poll inbound (no public URL), text and media. Disclosure — sends the API key and message content, files included, only to Meta: api.whatsapp.com, plus lookaside.fbsbx.com for downloads (per WhatsApp's Third-Party Agents Terms, agent chats are not end-to-end encrypted); stores the poll cursor, recent message ids and the creator's id under HERMES_HOME; no other network egress, no telemetry, no self-update. Exception: Hermes fetches image URLs in replies (SSRF-guarded, no key), revealing the server's IP to that host. Files go only to the creator; Meta keeps uploads up to 30 days. Received files are cached under HERMES_HOME (deleted after ~24 h while the gateway runs) and may reach the configured model, vision or speech-to-text provider. WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_MEDIA_ENABLED=false disables media. By default only the agent's creator (verified through Meta's API) can message Hermes; WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_ALLOWED_USERS or WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_ALLOW_ALL_USERS widens that explicitly. The agent API key is saved to the Hermes .env; the state file under HERMES_HOME is 0600 and never contains the key. This plugin requires env var(s): WHATSAPP_AGENT_PLATFORM_API_KEY. Requires Hermes >=0.21.4.

entries.capability_summary: wicked-memory (community, maintained by choaticpixels) Persistent, wallet-scoped long-term memory for Hermes: remember, semantic recall, versioned update, history and approved hard delete, backed by the hosted Wicked Memory service, plus skills for using it and for connecting the Wicked MCP server. The bundled wicked-suite-mcp skill walks you through adding the author's hosted Wicked MCP server (https://mcp.wickedapi.com/mcp, 75 tools, some x402-priced); that server is a separate manual step and is not covered by this pin. This plugin registers tool(s): wicked_memory_remember, wicked_memory_recall, wicked_memory_update, wicked_memory_history, wicked_memory_forget, wicked_memory_whoami; hook(s): pre_tool_call. Requires Hermes >=0.21.5.

entries.capability_summary: woof (community, maintained by recastsystems) Plan, launch, watch and compare WOOF weather simulations on your own NVIDIA GPU: size runs with WOOF's own planner, launch them locally or on an ssh/WSL GPU host, get maps in the chat while the forecast runs, compare physics or resolution, run multi-arm research campaigns and score runs against radar and surface observations. Disclosure — runs need Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU (plan-only elsewhere); the user-run hermes woof install pip-installs recast-woof>=1.0.0,<1.1 into ~/woof-env and downloads WOOF tables and optional geography (about 1.6 GB); runs execute the WOOF CLI as detached background jobs writing to ~/woof-runs and fetch public weather data; run events are pushed into the chat as user-role messages; the optional serve/ scripts download llama.cpp and a Qwen GGUF and start an unauthenticated local model server. This plugin registers tool(s): woof_doctor, woof_catalog, woof_docs, woof_plan, woof_launch, woof_status, woof_stop, woof_show, woof_compare, woof_campaign, woof_score, woof_report; hook(s): pre_llm_call, post_llm_call, on_session_end.

entries.capability_summary: wyoming-voice-bridge (community, maintained by TakeshiTGAL) Wyoming speech-to-text and text-to-speech for a Wyoming server you run (stt/tts provider `wyoming`), plus a wyoming_voice_status tool that lists the server's models and voices. Disclosure — Audio and text to speak go to the WYOMING_* host:port you set over cleartext, unauthenticated TCP (public addresses accepted). Once selected, the providers send speech in every session, including cron and webhooks. Non-WAV audio is converted with your local ffmpeg. wyoming_voice_status asks for approval on each call and refuses under cron, yolo, approvals off, -q and unattended platforms; answering "always" leaves a command_allowlist line in config.yaml. It calls internal Hermes approval, config and write-guard helpers, so a Hermes update can disable the status tool or speech file writes (both fail closed). This plugin registers tool(s): wyoming_voice_status. Requires Hermes >=0.21.4.

entries.capability_summary: xchat (official, maintained by NousResearch) X Chat gateway platform: talk to Hermes in X's end-to-end encrypted DMs. Hermes runs as the X account you connect: chat with it in your own self-chat ("message yourself"), or give it a separate account and DM that. Messages are decrypted and encrypted locally with X's official Chat XDK, so X only routes ciphertext. Encrypted media, threaded replies, group mention gating and cron delivery. This plugin requires env var(s): XCHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN. Requires Hermes >=0.21.5.

entries.capability_summary: xmemo (community, maintained by yonro) Native XMemo memory provider for Hermes Agent — durable, identity-aware cross-session memory with semantic search. Disclosure — cloud memory provider: sends each user prompt (for recall), model-written memories and mirrored built-in Hermes memory writes, plus a stable install ID, to xmemo.dev (Yonro Co., Ltd.); reuses the xmemo login token from ~/.config/xmemo if present. This plugin requires env var(s): XMEMO_KEY. Requires Hermes >=0.19.

entries.capability_summary: yantrikdb (community, maintained by yantrikos) Persistent memory for Hermes. Canonicalizes duplicate memories, surfaces contradictions between structured or recognized single-valued claims for review, and returns a why_retrieved reason list with every recall. Embedded by default: no server, no token, no GPU. Optional HTTP backend for HA clusters; pluggable embedders (bundled potion-2M default). This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars.

entries.capability_summary: you (community, maintained by youdotcom-oss) You.com skills for live web search, URL content extraction, cited research, finance research, and integration discovery via the You.com MCP servers (api.you.com). Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/, five skills bundled); auth via YDC_API_KEY, OAuth, or MPP/x402 — the free profile works keyless. This plugin declares no tools, hooks, middleware, or env vars. Requires Hermes >=0.20.

entries.capability_summary: zalo-platform (community, maintained by moken627-hub) Zalo Bot Platform gateway adapter for Hermes Agent — relays messages between Zalo DMs/groups and the agent over the official Bot API (bot-api.zaloplatforms.com), long-polling or webhook mode. Adds slash commands and moderation. Zero extra dependencies (uses httpx, already a Hermes dependency). Production-tested on multiple Vietnamese deployments. Disclosure — connects to the third-party Zalo Bot API (bot-api.zaloplatforms.com) with your bot token; long-polling by default, or opt-in webhook mode with a listener on 127.0.0.1 by default that checks the X-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header; the setup wizard writes ZALO_* values to ~/.hermes/.env; group chat history is stored locally under <HERMES_HOME>/zalo-history. This plugin requires env var(s): ZALO_BOT_TOKEN. Requires Hermes >=0.19.
